html:
Mzilikazi was the founder of the Ndebele kingdom, a general who broke away from the Zulu king Shaka in the 1820s and led his followers across the highveld to settle in what is now western Zimbabwe.

His army, organised in regiments on the Zulu model, raided and absorbed peoples on the way, in the wars of the Mfecane. After defeats by Boer trekkers and Zulu armies in 1836 and 1837, he moved north across the Limpopo.

There, around Bulawayo, he built a powerful state that ruled over and raided neighbouring Shona communities. He allowed missionaries and traders in, though few converts were made. His son Lobengula lost the kingdom to Cecil Rhodes's company.
